title: Seismically determined elastic parameters for Earth’s outer core (EPOC)
key_result: EPOC fits normal-mode data better than PREM; outer-core velocity/density profiles differ materially. EPOC reduced overall reduced chi^2 from 1.54 to 1.02 and outer-core-sensitive modes from 2.51 to 0.74; density is ~0.94–1.25% above PREM across the core.
allowed_use: Add an EPOC-vs-PREM reference-Earth sensitivity gate for any H0 travel-time/density anomaly claim.
not_allowed: Do not treat EPOC as evidence for a central black hole or as a unique true Earth model.

title: Earth’s core composition and core formation
key_result: Review: Earth’s core is mainly Fe–Ni plus ~10% lighter elements whose identities and abundances remain uncertain; composition is constrained jointly by geochemistry and high-P/T mineral physics.
allowed_use: Use as a high-level domain constraint: full Fe–Ni–light-element closure must span composition uncertainty rather than silently assuming one binary alloy.
not_allowed: Do not convert the review into missing thermodynamic derivatives or transport coefficients.

title: Thermal conductivity of Fe-Si alloys and thermal stratification in Earth’s core
key_result: Experiments plus FPMD/DMFT on Fe-Si; liquid Fe-9Si near topmost outer-core conditions gives thermal conductivity ~100–110 W m^-1 K^-1.
allowed_use: Benchmark/validation anchor for Fe-Si electronic/thermal transport in its stated P-T-X domain.
not_allowed: Thermal/electrical conductivity is not a free electron diffusion coefficient and not a multicomponent ionic Onsager matrix.

title: Transport properties of Fe-Ni-Si alloys at Earth's core conditions
key_result: Electrical resistivity measured for Fe-10wt%Ni and Fe-1.8wt%Si to ~142 GPa and ~3400 K; nominal topmost-outer-core thermal conductivity ~50 W m^-1 K^-1 is modeled for Fe-5Ni-8Si.
allowed_use: Independent validation bracket for electronic/thermal transport and composition sensitivity.
not_allowed: The modeled ternary thermal conductivity is not a species-resolved mass-transport matrix and not a direct A35 charge-capture closure.

title: Review of the second charged-particle transport coefficient code comparison workshop
key_result: Multi-code comparison of charged-particle transport in high-energy-density/WDM regimes; documents model dependence and benchmark methodology.
allowed_use: Use for uncertainty protocol and inter-code comparison.
not_allowed: Do not import workshop coefficients as Fe–Ni–Light core transport closure unless exact composition/state/domain match is demonstrated.

title: Towards first principles-based simulations of dense hydrogen
key_result: Kubo-Greenwood is a standard DFT route for electronic transport; workshop comparisons report ~20% best-case weak-coupling spread ~factor 2 in WDM and up to factor 10+ at low T; ionization uncertainty is a major disagreement source.
allowed_use: Strengthen explicit model-uncertainty and ionization-closure gates.
not_allowed: Hydrogen results are not transferable numerical coefficients for liquid Fe–Ni–Light.

title: Researchers track plasma creation using novel ultra-fast laser method
key_result: Pump-probe method combines ultrafast laser heating with X-ray free-electron-laser probing of warm dense copper on picosecond timescales.
allowed_use: Candidate experimental-method reference for future WDM diagnostics/data acquisition.
not_allowed: Copper WDM dynamics do not close Fe–Ni–Light core transport.

title: Interfacial thermal resistance in high-energy-density plasma
key_result: Experiment finds strong interfacial thermal resistance caused by electron scattering across a material interface.
allowed_use: Supports keeping an explicit interface/matching operator rather than assuming transparent local equilibration.
not_allowed: This is not evidence for a black-hole/WDM Q_bullet→Q_m map and does not specify capture K_s.

title: Primordial Black Holes from non-Gaussian fluctuations
key_result: PBH abundance is governed by the tail of the perturbation distribution and primordial non-Gaussian tails can materially change abundance.
allowed_use: Supports F12 requirement to specify the non-Gaussian distribution/convention rather than infer abundance from power amplitude alone.
not_allowed: Does not determine project A_peak or f_NL without a concrete formation model.

title: Gravitational waves from incomplete inflationary phase transitions
key_result: Paper states a PBH constraint assuming Gaussian P_R is only a rough estimate; exact abundance bound requires model-specific non-Gaussian statistics.
allowed_use: Promote model-specific non-Gaussian mapping to a hard F12 gate.
not_allowed: Do not reuse the paper phase-transition spectrum as the project primordial spectrum.

title: Strong constraints on primordial black hole dark matter from 16 years of INTEGRAL/SPI observations
key_result: No NFW-shaped PBH component was detected; 95% CL limits were set under a Galactic halo population model.
not_allowed: Not an exclusion of one hypothetical Earth-center black hole; geometry population model and mass range differ.

title: Super-Kamiokande-IV solar neutrino analysis
key_result: SK-IV solar analysis uses 22.5 kt fiducial volume 2970 live days and 3.49 MeV electron kinetic-energy threshold.
allowed_use: Detector configuration/performance context and calibration anchor.
not_allowed: Not an official Super-K Earth-center evaporating-black-hole search.

title: NSF GEO Core / Structure and Physics of the Solid Earth
key_result: Current NSF geoscience programs support foundational work on Earth’s interior and core-to-crust structure/physics.
allowed_use: Track relevant Earth-interior/seismic/mineral-physics projects awards and datasets.
not_allowed: Funding-program scope is not scientific evidence.

title: NSF Plasma Physics (NSF 26-523)
key_result: Program explicitly covers high-energy-density and strongly coupled plasmas with experiment theory and computation.
allowed_use: Discovery route for future WDM transport/ionization work and research groups/awards.
not_allowed: Program scope is not closure data.

title: NSF MATRIX-MIP / Materials Innovation Platforms
key_result: NSF announced MATRIX-MIP for materials in extreme environments and shared synthesis/characterization/modeling infrastructure.
allowed_use: Track infrastructure/network discovery for extreme-condition materials methodology.
not_allowed: Announcement does not establish Earth-core Fe–Ni–Light WDM transport capability.

title: NSF Public Access Repository + Award Search
key_result: NSF-PAR provides public NSF-funded publications and Award Search links awards to outputs; dataset metadata is expanding.
not_allowed: Repository presence alone does not upgrade a source to direct physical closure data.
